address: 7 Mount Street Lower, Dublin City, D02 WK33, Ireland
bio: The famed French chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten, who owns restaurants all over the world, has now expanded his empire to the Emerald Isle with this top-floor restaurant inside The Leinster hotel. It’s a cosy and comfortable place, with floor-to-ceiling windows and an awning-covered terrace allowing for prime city views. The extensive menu includes Jean-Georges signatures like egg toast with caviar, alongside a range of international influences from rigatoni with meatballs to spiced chicken samosas....
